### Added

- *(aggregator)* Relay a backend's URL elicitation, from allowlisted servers to the Dev Portal only in [#1769](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1769) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(aggregator)* Complete a relayed backend URL elicitation: wait for and pass on elicitation/complete in [#1773](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1773) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
- *(mcpserver)* Spec.auth.grantScope makes a server that discovers its authorization server subject-scoped in [#1757](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1757) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)

### Fixed

- *(aggregator)* Sweep the sign-ins of gone organization namespaces after a restart in [#1774](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1774) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
